'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Terwilliger LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Terwilliger]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
